enchantments.tooltip: Armor Bonus +6: This item surrounds the wearer with an invisible but tangible field of force, granting +6 armor bonus to AC, just as though he were wearing armor.
Protection +4: Passive: +4 Deflection bonus to Armor Class.
Resistance +4: Passive: +4 Resistance bonus to Fortitude, Reflex, and Will Saving Throws.
Fire Guard II: When Hit in Melee: Deals 2 to 8 Fire damage to your attacker.
Ice Guard II: When Hit in Melee: Deals 2 to 8 Cold damage to your attacker.
